description: This file defines the CandidateMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. Its primary purpose is to configure menu items related to the candidate view in the OrangeHRM recruitment module, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewCandidates'.

classes.name: CandidateMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements menu configuration for candidate-related screens in the recruitment module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module's screen to 'viewCandidates' using a helper trait. Returns null as it doesn't generate a menu item directly.
